name: launch-film
description: A launch film from a website or an App Store page: its real logo, colors, fonts and screens, rendered locally with Chrome and ffmpeg.

interface.longDescription: Makes a 20 to 40 second launch film with music from a product's website or App Store page, using its real logo, colors, fonts and screens. Renders locally with Chrome and ffmpeg. Needs Node 22 or newer and no API key.
defaultPrompt: Make a launch video for linear.app
